text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Th-The unrivaled festival girl! Lighting 
up your heart—wait, huh?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Calm down, your smile is looking stiff☆ 
Smiling is an umadol's top priority☆ 
Right?☆"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The road to becoming an umadol is harsh. 
As for why things turned out like this, 
the story goes back several hours—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I see! The date is set, but there aren't 
enough performers for the live show!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Suzuka-chan, Ines-san, and 
everyone else have plans!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And that's when Kita-chan showed up♪ The 
moment I saw her, it was like *zapping*☆ 
love at first sight!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
How about it!? Want to try becoming an 
Umadol?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
U-Um! Well, yes, I still don't really know 
much about being an Umadol, but...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Still, if you're in trouble, I'd be more 
than happy to help!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
—No, I mean, I did say so casually that 
I'd help out earlier, but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Giving a cute self-introduction is 
already tough enough! It's kind of 
embarrassing, you know?!"
choice_data_list: Being an Umadol sure is tough.
Being an Umadol is pretty tough, huh?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
B-But still! Kita-chan, you really are 
overflowing with raw talent~☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Bright, energetic, and handsome-cute☆ 
Plus, she doesn't overlap with Falco's 
brand at all, which is the best!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So let's not get discouraged and keep on 
training♪ Once you finish your 
self-introduction, we'll practice your 
call-and-response and autographs too☆

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hyeeeeh~! I-I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the days of special training went 
by—

text_block_list.name: Umadol Fans
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waiting, everyone♪ Dashing 
smartly straight into your heart♪ It's 
Smart Falcon☆

text_block_list.name: Umadol Fans
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOH!! Falcooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... What incredible cheering...! 
Alright, I'm gonna—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Th-The unrivaled festival girl! Lighting 
up fireworks right into your heart! I'm 
Kitasan Black!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaa! Kita-chan is so cute~! Look this 
way, please~!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Dia-chan, what are you doing!? 
E-Even Trainer-san, too!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm happy, but you really don't have to 
force yourself to call me 'cute'—

text_block_list.name: Umadol Fans
text_block_list.text: So cuuuute!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh, wh-why such a reaction!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It just means Kita-chan is su~per adorable 
when she gets all flustered by praise☆

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hyeeek! B-But how am I supposed to reply 
to this...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hyeeek! B-But how am I supposed to reply 
to this...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "S-Smiles are life☆ ...Or so it went!"

text_block_list.name: Umadol Fans
text_block_list.text: So cuuute!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Fufu, isn't that right? Isn't it adorable?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Still, I've known just how cute Kita-chan 
is for a really long time♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha...! Thank you, everyone! Thank you 
too, Dia-chan~!

text_block_list.name: Umadol Fans
text_block_list.text: (Uwoooo~~ah!!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, just as I thought~☆ Kita-chan, you 
totally have the makings of an Umadol♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the Umadol concert was a massive 
success. Later on, Kitasan Black would 
receive an enthusiastic scout from Smart 
Falcon.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ah, comiiing!

text_block_list.name: Umadol Fans
text_block_list.text:
Over here too! Look over this way, 
pleaaase!!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Um, like this!?

text_block_list.name: Umadol Fans
text_block_list.text: (Uwoooo~~ah!!)

text_block_list.name: Male Umadol Fan
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black... She might be the one... I 
could totally root for her!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Looking good, looking good! The special 
training is paying off☆ Alright then, 
let's keep the momentum going and start a 
song~☆

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yes! Everyone, please listen! The song is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps her earnest dedication won over 
the crowd, as a long line formed for the 
post-concert handshake event.
